A.biggest_strength: Comprehensive, deeply accurate coverage of 14 languages across paradigms with synchronized code highlighting, stack frame visualization, and machine/runtime ABI insights.
A.biggest_weakness: A minor text discrepancy claiming '13 languages' in the header while providing 14 tabs, and lack of an explicit prefers-reduced-motion media query for frame animations.
factual_errors: Subtitle states '13 languages' while the selector and comparison table actually provide 14 targets (13 high-level languages plus x86-64 assembly).
